extracted.intended_audience: intellectual property practitioners, national IP offices, legal researchers, and applicants interested in appellations of origin and geographical indications
extracted.subtask_description: A tabulated status list of States and IGOs that are parties to the Lisbon Agreement (and its Stockholm/Geneva Acts), showing dates of accession/ratification and footnoted declarations. Useful as a reference for which jurisdictions participate and any special declarations or reservations they made.
